## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: signs and traffic signals
Knowledge facts: part C holds 53 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 15 to 24; part C2 holds 17 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 - 2027 manual, the 35-question count and the 28-of-35 passing standard from physical page 10; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- OR-SIGN-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- OR-SIGN-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- OR-SIGN-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: electronic speed and advisory signs and safety corridor designations (for example sec02-F09, sec02-F40) can change and must be refreshed from Oregon DMV and ODOT sources.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E
